terms.meaning: One of three post categories: a personal goal the donee wants to fulfil with community help.
terms.context: Post type / category / feed filters / creation flow
exceptions: Brand/product name dreamhubb is never translated.
terms.notes: UI often uses lowercase in running text; category labels may be title case.

terms.meaning: Post category for a difficulty the donee wants help solving.
terms.context: Post type / category / feed filters / creation flow

terms.meaning: Post category for an idea seeking support, feedback, or resources.
terms.context: Post type / category / feed filters / creation flow

terms.meaning: User role / side focused on helping others (browse feed, contribute, earn tokens).
terms.notes: Product term; keep consistent across UI.

terms.meaning: User role / side focused on sharing dreams/problems/ideas and receiving help.
terms.context: Onboarding side picker, post creation, profiles
terms.notes: English product term 'Donee' may remain in some partial packs; SK catalog uses Príjemca.

terms.meaning: User-generated content item (dream/problem/idea) shown in feed and detail.
terms.notes: Do not confuse with social-network 'post' jargon in other products.

terms.meaning: Main scrolling list of posts for the current side/filters.
exceptions: SK may keep 'Feed' as loanword in some strings — OPEN for terminology review.
terms.notes: OPEN: confirm preferred SK rendering (Feed vs Prehľad/Nástenka) with product.

terms.meaning: Act of offering non-token or message-based support on a post (contribution_type help), and general support UI.
terms.context: Help flow CTA, contribution type, support pages
terms.notes: Distinct from Token top-up / donate flows.

terms.meaning: A help/comment action attached to a post (message, optional return_message), including replies.
exceptions: SK UI may use 'komentár' in comment chrome — OPEN if contribution ≠ comment.
terms.notes: OPEN: align Contribution vs Comment terminology in SK.

terms.meaning: Ambiguous in product copy: may refer to token top-up or general giving. Requires product confirmation before locking SK.
terms.notes: OPEN: do not invent a SK equivalent until product confirms meaning vs Token top-up.

terms.meaning: In-app virtual currency unit used for rewards, shop, and post top-ups.
terms.context: Token shop, earn, balances, post funding
terms.notes: Brand/product currency name — intentional unchanged candidate.

terms.meaning: Tokens granted for completing Earn tasks or similar incentives.
Post/dream reached its goal / marked accomplished.

Profile achievement/badge shown on user profiles.
